families.reason: dogs.js and the artwork review render each approved generated portrait from the card/detail variant URLs in the runtime manifest; the URLs are data, not literals, so the manifest declares them. Bytes and SHA-256 must match the manifest.

The artwork review builds the cohort E batch URLs with Array.from({ length: 10 }); the other batch documents are literal URLs discovered statically. Batch fetches are optional at runtime, so a missing file would silently drop provenance instead of failing.
